title: 법무장교의 선발에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00907:20161129:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Military Service Act <Ordinance No. 907, November 29, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on November 30, 2016.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (4) Omitted.
(5) Part of the Rules on the Selection of Legal Officers shall be amended as follows:
In the portion of Article 2 other than its subparagraphs, "physical classification (신체등위)" shall be replaced with "physical grade (신체등급)".
In Article 5 (1) 1, "whose physical classification is" shall be replaced with "whose physical grade is"; in the former sentence of paragraph (3) of the same Article, "whose physical classification is" shall be replaced with "whose physical grade is"; and in the latter sentence of that paragraph, "physical classification" shall be replaced with "physical grade".
(6) through (11) Omitted.
